verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show any documented way to build custom views or dashboard widgets that render natively inside Jira. 'Extend Jira Software with apps', the 3000+ Marketplace integrations and 'Rich APIs' are generic ecosystem and developer building blocks, not a documented native UI-extension capability. The built-in board, list, timeline and calendar views are a different, adjacent feature, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
